proposal.recommendation: Sample three, park three, and give every parked concept a trigger
proposal.recommendation_detail: The three durable-trend candidates that existing suppliers can make are worth $9.4K of the $24K budget. The three fads are parked with the evidence and a named condition that would re-open them — a parked concept with no trigger is a concept nobody will ever look at again.

slate.name: Carbon steel wok 12"
slate.rationale: Highest affinity in the set, best supplier fit, and the only concept that needs no tooling commitment. If one thing gets sampled this cycle it is this.
criteria: Hammering finish consistent across all three units in round one.
Seasoning takes evenly at 400°F with no warping on a home range.
Quoted unit cost holds at $19.40 at MOQ 500 after sample changes.
Handle weld passes a 40 lb static load with no deflection.

slate.name: Whetstone angle guide
slate.rationale: Cheapest and fastest concept on the list with the highest margin. Small ceiling at $34K a year, but it captures demand our own whetstone buyers are currently taking elsewhere.
criteria: Holds 15° and 20° within 0.5° across five units.
Fits our existing 1000/6000 stone without a shim.
Survives 200 sharpening passes with no visible wear.

slate.name: Enamel roasting dish set
slate.rationale: Strong durability read and Arcadia is our best supplier on every standard. The $4.2K mould deposit is the whole argument — it goes before the first sample exists.
criteria: Enamel matches the existing colourway within ΔE 2.0.
No chipping after 20 thermal cycles between 40°F and 500°F.
Nesting works in the existing carton footprint — no new box size.
Second RFQ confirms unit cost at $26.80 or better at MOQ 300.
